text: 国机重装公告，公司拟向特定对象发行A股股票，募集资金总额不超过4.44亿元，扣除发行费用后全部用于补充流动资金，发行对象为国机集团并以现金认购全部股票。本次发行方案已获董事会审议通过，尚需履行国资审批、股东会审议、上交所审核及中国证监会注册等程序。
text_en: Sinomach Heavy Equipment announced that the company plans to issue A-shares to specific targets, with total fundraising not exceeding RMB 444 million. After deducting issuance expenses, all proceeds will be used to supplement working capital. The issuance target is Sinomach Group, which will subscribe to all shares in cash. The issuance plan has been approved by the board of directors and still requires state-owned asset approval, shareholder meeting review, Shanghai Stock Exchange review, and CSRC registration.
